drivers: Small, simple 5-square shape (2x3 with a missing corner) is easy to hold in working memory
Chiral shape: all distractors are mirror images, so the only cue is handedness, which demands genuine mental rotation rather than feature matching
Diagonal 45°/135° rotations make alignment to the grid harder and increase mirror confusions
Both-correct scoring compounds errors across two independent judgments; 30 s limit is adequate but adds pressure
